title: Why was there an 'evil’ Delta airlines Wi-Fi network? The experts weigh in
summary: What they didn’t know was that ‘Delta WiFi Fast’ was actually a fake network, allegedly set up by a fellow passenger intended to mimic the actual onboard Wi-Fi network and scam other users.
